The project aims to combat the rising rates of acute malnutrition caused by factors such as poor food consumption patterns, extreme poverty, food insecurity, displacement, inadequate nutrition knowledge, and high morbidity rates. Additionally, the project will address the anticipated nutrition needs of the communities during the lean season.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gt

Children admitted to the program who will undergo an 8-week treatment and subsequently be discharged. 1100 (650 girls and 550 boys) lt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gtchildren and 220 PLW will be reached.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size:12.0pt font-family:"gtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:automso-margin-bottom-alt:auto text-align:justifyline-height:normal"gtltspan lang="EN-GB" style="font-size:12.0pt font-family:"gtTo reach communities that are not close to static Outpatient Therapeutic (OTP) sites or are often cut off during the rainy season, the project will implement a mobile OTP intervention. To overcome accessibility challenges during the peak of the rainy season, materials such as life vests, raincoats, and rain boots will be procured to strengthen capacity and reach isolated communities. Of this number, the project targets referral services for 100 (60females, 40males) SAM cases with complicationslt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gt to the stabilization centerslt/spangtltspan lang="EN-GB" style="font-size: 12.0ptfont-family:"gt will be facilitated using an ambulance.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:automso-margin-bottom-alt:auto text-align:justifyline-height:normal"gtltspan lang="EN-GB" style="font-size:12.0pt font-family:"gtlt/spangtltspan lang="EN-GB" style="font-size: 12pt"gtThe project will integrate hygiene and sanitation promotion reaching 12000 (2000 men, 5000 women, 2000 boys, 3000 girls) with WASH and GBV sensitization, referral of GBV identified cases, GBV psychosocial support as measures to prevent and mitigate gender-based violence (GBV), ensuring a holistic approach to improving the overall well-being of the community. lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 12pt"gtThis approach aims to improve knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) among community members. The production of SBCC (Social and Behaviour Change Communication) materials, including counselling cards, cooking demonstration manuals, and sensitization messaging aligned with lean and rainy seasons, will be undertaken. lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtBy implementing these actions, ActionAid Nigeria aims to effectively address the nutrition crisis in Busari LGA, Yobe State, and improve the health and well-being of children under 5, pregnant women, and lactating women, while also enhancing the resilience of communities during challenging seasons.lt/spangtltbrgtltbrgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtAANlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt is currently implementing a TSPF programme in the LGA but for this project, AAN has prioritized communities not covlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtered under the current TSPF programme, however the mobile OTP will be implemented in all lt/spangthard-to-reachltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt communities where a static OTP is not present.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="" style=""gtltspan lang="EN-GB" style="font-size: 12pt"gtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gt
